locator.section: Eq. 8.2, arrow 2.0, rH (secondary: acetone enol+. -> CH3CO+ + .CH3)

evidence.curator_note: Secondary fragmentation of the m/z-58 acetone enol radical cation: an H-rearrangement ('rH') tautomerises it (O-H hydrogen H8 migrates from O6 back onto the terminal C4) and a methyl radical is lost, giving the acetylium CH3-C#O+ (m/z 43). No abundance % is printed for this arrow (dHf only). This is the enol-ion -> acetone-ketone-ion -> acylium + .CH3 route drawn as a single arrow; the intermediate acetone radical cation is NOT drawn, so it is not added as a state. Book draws 0 electron-pushing arcs: Eq. 8.2 is a thermochemical fragmentation map (log k printed above each reaction arrow, heats of formation printed below each species), not a curved-arrow figure. All electron moves here are curator-inferred from the mechanism-type label printed under the reaction arrow; none is drawn on the page. FIVE fishhooks producing the drawn O-centred enol -> acylium change: move<1> (2e) the C4=C5 pi pair captures the incoming H8 as the new C4-H8 bond; move<2> (2e) the O6-H8 pair feeds into the forming C5#O6+ triple bond; move<3> one C4-C5 (sigma) electron becomes the radical on the departing methyl C4; move<4> the other C4-C5 electron feeds the C5#O6+ bond; move<5> the O6 odd electron completes the C5#O6+ triple bond. Net: H8 relocates O6->C4, C4 leaves as .CH3, and C5-O6 goes single->triple.

Cross-linked to IMS_8_2_rH_2_0. It captures the same net change (H10=my H8 migrates to their C1=my C4, which departs as the methyl radical [C.]1(H2)(H3)(H10); the acetyl fragment their C4(-C5)-O9 = my C5(-C7)-O6 remains as the cation) BUT is doubly mis-encoded: its reactant enol writes the central carbon (their C4=my C5) with FIVE bonds (=C1, -C5, =O9) -- pentavalent -- and its product acylium '[C]4...[O+]9' has a SINGLE C-O bond (divalent C, no C#O+ triple). This record encodes the RDKit-valid O-centred enol and the true acylium. Listed in rule_mismatches.
